climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A New York AVA around the Hudson River in the southeast, covering about 2.2 million acres across Columbia, Dutchess, Putnam and parts of other counties. In Ulster County, Seyval Blanc and De Chaunac are the leading grapes.
